c.is_visible = true
AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.keyword}, '%'))
AND c.parent_id = #{params.parentId}
AND c.parent_id IS NULL

mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, c.sort_order, c.post_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN categories p ON c.parent_id = p.id
ORDER BY c.parent_id IS NULL DESC, c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM categories c LEFT JOIN categories p ON c.parent_id = p.id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, c.sort_order, c.post_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM categories c LEFT JOIN categories p ON c.parent_id = p.id WHERE c.id = #{categoryId} AND c.is_visible = true

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, c.sort_order, c.post_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM categories c LEFT JOIN categories p ON c.parent_id = p.id WHERE c.slug = #{slug} AND c.is_visible = true

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, c.sort_order, c.post_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM categories c LEFT JOIN categories p ON c.parent_id = p.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.is_visible = true ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
